name: I Was A Teenage Vampire
source: Silver Lake, 1989. You're just a broke teenager trying to survive high school, get a job, and maybe buy your first car. But when strange disappearances shake your small town and a mysterious girl flashes her fangs, your world turns upside down. Part comedy, part horror, I Was a Teenage Vampire is a nostalgic, adult-themed visual novel inspired by 1980s teen movies. Experience love, fear, and the supernatural in a branching story where your choices matter and growing up might just get you killed.
